text: いわない　なら　こおりづけに　なるわよ…！

structure.jp: こおりづけに　なるわよ…！
structure.en: you'll end up frozen in ice...!

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is how it is'. いわない　なら = 'if you won't talk'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: こおりづけに　なる
patterns.explanation: に なる after a word says what something turns into. こおりづけに　なる = 'you'll become frozen solid'.
